gloss: full dress; formal attire; dressed up

definitions.gloss: full dress; formal attire; being dressed up; best clothes
definitions.explanation: Wearing one's finest or most formal clothing for a special occasion. Implies making an effort to dress elegantly and impressively.

examples.japanese: {盛装|せいそう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦パーティー→パーティー：02946_paatii⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}かけた→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: I dressed up and went to the party.

examples.japanese: ⟦{招待客|しょうたいきゃく}→招待客：28262_shoutaikyaku⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{盛装|せいそう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: The invited guests gathered at the venue in their finest attire.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ふさわしい{盛装|せいそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}した→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧。
examples.english: I attended in formal attire appropriate for a wedding.

notes:
Compound of {盛|せい} (grand, magnificent) + {装|そう} (attire, dress). Refers to dressing up in one's best clothes for a formal or special occasion.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {盛装|せいそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to dress up, to put on formal attire
- {盛装|せいそう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧: to go out dressed up
- {盛装|せいそう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧: a figure in full dress

NOTE ON HOMOPHONES:
- ⟦{正装|せいそう}→正装：16053_seisou⟧: formal dress — very similar in meaning but emphasizes adherence to dress code rather than personal elegance
- ⟦{清掃|せいそう}→清掃：04332_seisou⟧: cleaning — completely different meaning

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{正装|せいそう}→正装：16053_seisou⟧: formal dress — focuses on following dress code requirements
- ⟦{着飾|きかざ}る→着飾る：15040_kikazaru⟧: to dress up — a verb meaning to adorn oneself
- {おめかし: dressing up — more casual, often used for women and children
